error.message: The browser at http://127.0.0.1:9336 is running but did not accept a connection within 8 s. Most likely a page dialog (alert/confirm/prompt/'Leave site?') is waiting for an answer: answer it in the window (the user, or OS-level tools such as computer-use on Linux). Otherwise a page may be hung. Headless browsers have no window: close the tab or restart that browser.
